blocks.text: Condo buildings in Westham Island Guide

Westham Island is a Fraser River estuary farm island off Ladner whose documented land base is farmland (more than 700 hectares) under the Agricultural Land Reserve frame, and ALR residences cannot be stratified (standing correction) — so the island's housing is farmhouses and acreages, plus float homes at the Westham Island Marina that are moorage-tenure product, not strata condos. The former westham-island.html page was intentionally deleted on October 23, 2026 and must return 404; this -guide page is its live replacement — that 404 is expected, not a defect.
Streets, schools and getting around Westham Island Guide

items.t: Identity: Westham Island is a real island in the Fraser River estuary off Ladner, City of Delta — Environment and Climate Change Canada places the island's Alaksen National Wildlife Area just under 10 km west of Ladner in the Municipality of Delta, reached by crossing the bridge to Westham Island and following Westham Island Road, and the Province states the Westham Island Bridge is the island's only road access point. The feed cards carry "Westham Island" as their sub-area label and the guide page's FAQ calls it "an MLS® area name with its own map lines" (site copy); the board sub-area code is not verified, and whether the board's map lines match the island's shoreline is not verified.

The guide page's feed snapshot: three cards read — two float homes at 3 and 4 – 3350 Westham Island Road and one vacant-land card at 3995 Trim Road, all labelled Westham Island, Status: Active; no feed-count header was visible, so no total count is stated. The page's "For sale" quick link points to the Ladner homes for sale page, not to a Westham Island feed page.

Nearby areas: Ladner across Canoe Pass to the east; Tsawwassen to the south; Steveston (Richmond) across the Fraser River's south arm to the north. Port Guichon — named here only to fix its geography — is in Ladner, not Tsawwassen and not on Westham Island.

Where condo stock concentrates: nowhere on the island. There is no apartment building, strata complex or condo project on Westham Island in any source read; the documented land base is farmland — more than 700 hectares producing seed potatoes, vegetables, berries, forage and pasture, plus fruit, honey and livestock, with the island producing more than 25% of B.C.'s seed potatoes per the Province.
Transit and commute: no TransLink route serving Westham Island itself was verified pass, and no official source publishes driving commute times from the island to Vancouver or Richmond: Not verified.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Westham Island Guide

items.t: No stratification in the ALR (standing rule): ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)). ALC residence caps on ALR land: a principal residence is limited to 500 m² or less total floor area, with no more than 1,000 m² of fill placed for its construction; a secondary suite is permitted only within the principal residence; and one additional residence may be permitted at up to 90 m² total floor area on properties of 40 ha or less, or up to 186 m² on properties over 40 ha, with local government rules also applying.

BC Assessment farm class (standing figures): farm-class thresholds are $2,500 of farm income for land of 0.8–4 ha, $2,500 plus 5% of the value of land over 4 ha, and $10,000 for land under 0.8 ha, with applications by October 31 — the class test a small island acreage purchase has to plan around; verify the current-year figures with BC Assessment for a specific property before relying on them.
Delta zoning — number CONTESTED, flagged, not settled: The one island zoning fact on an official sample is parcel-level: 2194 Westham Island Road is zoned Agriculture (A 1).

blocks.text: Good to know about Westham Island Guide

items.t: The bridge chronology, stated with its sources separated.

The guide's Parks card gives the George C. Reifel Migratory Bird Sanctuary as 648 hectares; the Sanctuary's own About page describes nearly 300 hectares of managed wetlands, natural marshes and low dykes.
The island grows a quarter of the province's seed potatoes.

The guide page's home-plate figures are a different measure from the ALC caps — and are not verified. The guide states (site copy) a farm home plate of up to 3,600 m² with one farm house, or 5,000 m² with an Additional Farm House; those figures were not checked against Delta's Agricultural Plan or Zoning Bylaw pass and are a different measure from the ALC floor-area limits (500 m² principal residence; 90/186 m² additional residence) — do not substitute one for the other.

One road, one bridge, seven or eight swings a day. The swing span swings 90 degrees to let boats pass, opening roughly seven or eight times a day, mainly for fishing boats, on partial single-lane operation — a daily scheduling fact for showings, inspections and movers that no listing mentions, on top of the 50-ton load limit for farm equipment moves.

What trades here

items.t: Farm scale (Province): Westham Island produces more than 25% of B.C.'s seed potatoes, plus other fruit and vegetables, honey and livestock, on more than 700 hectares of land; crops include seed potatoes, vegetables and berries, plus forage and pasture.

Tenure — fee-simple is the default: the documented stock is farm parcels and farmhouses on fee-simple land; the guide feed also surfaces two float homes at the island marina address (feed snapshot only — moorage tenure, financing and insurance facts are not verified and no float-home land claim is made).
Named Westham Island bare-land strata community: none verified — none is asserted.

The feed's land card (snapshot, feed content only): one vacant-land card on Trim Road whose listing copy describes approximately 4.497 acres, land within the ALR and flood plain (DeltaMap), and A1 zoning (BC Assessment) — listing copy cited as feed evidence only; no lot count, subdivision name or servicing state is verified, and none is added.

Official parcel sample: a City of Delta report records 2194 Westham Island Road (Reynelda Farms Ltd.) as zoned Agriculture (A 1) and located within the Agricultural Land Reserve, a 65.2 ha site entirely within the ALR. The ALR status and zoning of any other specific island parcel: Not verified.
Farm-gate operations named on their own sources (context, not land inventory): Westham Island Herb Farm (business's own site) and Cropthorne Farm (named in the Province's release).

Lot character — ONLY: farmland parcels behind dikes on the Fraser River estuary, single-bridge access, and the guide's own framing bands (acreage 1–10 acres; farms 10 acres and up) recorded as site copy only, not adopted as fact.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Westham Island Guide

items.t: Westham Island is a real island in the Fraser River estuary off Ladner, City of Delta — Environment and Climate Change Canada places its Alaksen National Wildlife Area just under 10 km west of Ladner, reached by crossing the bridge and following Westham Island Road. The Province states the Westham Island Bridge is the island's only road access point. Nearby: Ladner across Canoe Pass to the east; Tsawwassen to the south; Steveston (Richmond) across the Fraser's south arm to the north.

Board position: the guide's FAQ calls Westham Island "an MLS® area name with its own map lines" (site copy) and feed cards carry "Westham Island" as their sub-area label; the board sub-area code is not verified, and whether the board's map lines match the island's shoreline is not verified.
The guide names Delta Secondary only. Catchments: no SD37 locator run for an island address is on record — not verified.

The bridge (TransLink): the Westham Island Bridge officially opened March 29, 1910; it is the oldest of the five bridges TransLink owns and operates, operated by TransLink since 1999, its narrowest bridge, a partial single-lane swing bridge over Canoe Pass (swing span opens roughly seven or eight times a day, mainly for fishing boats), with a load limit of 50 tons.

The 2026 strike, closure and reopening — both bases stated: the bridge was struck by a marine vessel on January 20, 2026 and closed to vehicles (significant damage to a primary support structure; emergency barge service funded during repairs).
Transit serving Westham Island itself: Not verified — no TransLink route serving the island was verified.

Flood protection: the island sits behind dikes; the City of Delta is the diking authority and operates over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 km of drainage infrastructure.
How people search for it: "Westham Island," "Westham Island Delta," "Westham Island farms," "Westham Island homes for sale," "Reifel Bird Sanctuary."

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Westham Island Guide

items.t: OCP — Delta: the consolidated Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), adopted July 8, 2024, applies — a single consolidated plan with NO lettered schedules; its designation list (s.1.5.1) does NOT include "Single Family Residential," and farm land is designated "Agriculture (A)." The former Ladner Area Plan was Schedule B.3 under the OLD Bylaw No. 3950 — never cite a lettered schedule as part of Bylaw 8400.
Zoning — Delta: the zoning bylaw number is CONTESTED (7600, 2017 vs "8400, 2025") — flagged in the status block, never asserted. The one official sample parcel is zoned Agriculture (A 1).

SSMUH — Delta: Bylaws 8394 + 8395 (June 24, 2024); Delta's SSMUH zoning allows up to 4 units on single-detached and duplex lots, with City support for accessory dwelling units such as coach houses, garden suites and secondary suites — on ALR land the ALC rules below govern first, and Delta's page does not override them.

ALR block (island farm ground): subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)). Caps: principal ≤500 m² total floor area (no more than 1,000 m² of fill for its construction), suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha), with local government rules also applying. Farm class three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR. The guide page's home-plate figures (3,600 m² / 5,000 m²) are a different measure, were not checked against Delta's Agricultural Plan or Zoning Bylaw, and are not verified here.

blocks.text: Good to know about Westham Island Guide

items.t: The island's only road was closed for weeks in 2026 (Province / City of Delta). The January 20, 2026 vessel strike damaged a primary support structure, shifted sections out of alignment and damaged a deck bearing, leaving the bridge unable to safely carry vehicle loads, with emergency barge service funded during repairs — single-access risk is a priced fact of island land, not a footnote.

Alaksen is four islands joined by dykes (Environment and Climate Change Canada). Alaksen National Wildlife Area (349 ha, established 1976) mainly consists of four former deltaic islands joined by causeways and dykes, is part of the Fraser River Delta Ramsar Site, and is open 8 a.m. to 3 p.m., Monday to Friday excluding statutory holidays.
The sanctuary's own size figure beats the guide's. The George C.

blocks.text: Good to know about Westham Island Guide

items.t: Flood protection is a City system, not a parcel feature: The island sits behind dikes on the Fraser River estuary; the City of Delta is the diking authority and operates and maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure.

Alaksen is four islands joined by dykes: Alaksen National Wildlife Area, 349 ha on Westham Island, was established in 1976 and mainly consists of four former deltaic islands joined by causeways and dykes; it is part of the Fraser River Delta Ramsar Site and of the Boundary Bay – Roberts Bank – Sturgeon Bank Important Bird Area, is managed by the Canadian Wildlife Service, and is open 8 a.m. to 3 p.m., Monday to Friday excluding statutory holidays. A section of Alaksen overlaps with the George C. Reifel Migratory Bird Sanctuary; both areas are reached through their front gates on Robertson Road (NWA gate 5421 Robertson Rd; sanctuary gate 5191 Robertson Rd).

Reifel Migratory Bird Sanctuary's size as 648 hectares — the Sanctuary's own About page describes nearly 300 hectares of managed wetlands, natural marshes and low dykes. The guide's figure is not adopted here.

faq.a: No. Zero verified apartment-condo buildings, and the legal frame makes strata stock structurally absent: the island's documented land base is ALR farmland (more than 700 hectares), and ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1)). The housing is farmhouses, acreages and marina float homes.
faq.q: Are there any condos on Westham Island?

faq.a: No. Listings record them as houses / floating homes at Westham Island Marina (one built 1989 on an IMFS concrete and foam barge, one built 1978), held on marina moorage — there is no strata lot, no Form B and no strata corporation. Moorage terms and fees for a specific unit: Not verified — get them from the marina and the listing documents before writing.
faq.q: Are the float homes at 3350 Westham Island Road condos?

faq.a: Not while the land is in the ALR: ALR residences cannot be stratified, a principal residence is capped at 500 m² total floor area, a suite is permitted only within that residence, and one additional residence is capped at 90 m² (40 ha or less) or 186 m² (over 40 ha). ALR status is parcel by parcel — check the exact address on the ALC map first.
faq.q: Can I stratify a farm property or build strata units on the island?

faq.a: By the Westham Island Bridge, the island's only road access — TransLink-owned, officially opened March 29, 1910, the oldest and narrowest of TransLink's five bridges, a partial single-lane swing bridge with a 50-ton load limit, swinging open roughly seven or eight times a day mainly for fishing boats. It was struck by a marine vessel on January 20, 2026 and closed to vehicles while a damaged support structure, shifted alignment and a damaged bearing were repaired, with emergency barge service funded during repairs; the guide page states it reopened to vehicles, pedestrians and cyclists on March 28, 2026 (site copy). Check the City of Delta's Westham Island updates page for current status before booking inspections or a move.
faq.q: How do you get to Westham Island, and what happened to the bridge in 2026?

faq.a: Ladner's Ministry-listed schools are Ladner Elementary (5016 44 Ave), Hawthorne Elementary (5160 Central Ave), Port Guichon Elementary (4381 46a St), Neilson Grove Elementary (5500 Admiral Blvd) and Delta Secondary (4615 51 St) — and the guide page names Delta Secondary as the secondary school in Ladner. The catchment for a specific island address is not verified: run it in the SD37 locator.

faq.a: None verified — count 0, strata and fee-simple.

faq.a: A marine vessel struck it on January 20, 2026 and it closed to vehicles for 67 days with emergency barge service running.
faq.q: What happened to the bridge in 2026?

faq.a: SnapStats publishes no South Delta figures at all — its Delta coverage is North Delta only.

faq.q: What wildlife areas are on Westham Island?

faq.a: The island sits behind dikes on the Fraser River estuary; the City of Delta is the diking authority. Ask whether the property is in a floodplain, what dike protects it, and get insurance quotes before removing subjects — the guide's own checklist directs exactly that.
faq.q: How is an island property protected from flooding?
What is Westham Island known for?
faq.a: Farming. The Province states the island produces more than 25% of B.C.'s seed potatoes, plus other fruit and vegetables, honey and livestock, on more than 700 hectares, alongside two federal wildlife areas.

faq.q: How do you get to Westham Island?
faq.a: By the Westham Island Bridge, the island's only road access — a TransLink-owned, partial single-lane swing bridge over Canoe Pass, opened March 29, 1910, with a 50-ton load limit; check the City of Delta's updates page for its current status before travelling.

faq.q: Is Westham Island in the ALR?
faq.a: ALR status is set property by property, so check the exact address on the ALC map; where land is in the ALR, a principal residence is capped at 500 m² total floor area, a suite is allowed only inside that residence, and one additional residence is capped at 90 m² (40 ha or less) or 186 m² (over 40 ha).
